spans.s:
श्यान p. p. [श्यै क्त]
1 Gone.
--2
Coagulated, congealed.
--3 Thick,
sticky, viscous.
--4 Shrunk, dry;
शरदि सरितः श्यानपुलिनाः

स्यन्न p. p.
1 Oozed, trickled,
dropped.
--2 Dropping, trickling (as
water).

श्याम a. [श्यै-मक]
1 Black, dark-blue,
dark-coloured; प्रत्याख्यात विशेषकं
कुरबकं श्यामावदातारुणं

.
--2 Brown.
--3 Shady, dusky.
--4 Dark-green.
--नः
1 The black colour.
--2 The
green colour.
--3 A cloud.
--4 The
cuckoo.
--5 N. of a sacred fig-tree at
Allahabad on the bank of the
Yamunā; अयं च कालिंदीतटे वटः श्यामो
नाम

.
--6 The thorn
apple.
--मं
1 Sea-salt.
--2 Black
pepper.
--Comp.
--अंग a. dark.
--(गः) the planet Mercury.
--कंठः
{1} an epithet of Śiva; (नीलकंठ).
{2} a peacock.
--कर्णः a horse
suitable for a horse sacrifice.
--पत्रः the
tamāla tree.
--भास्, --रुचि a.
glossy-black.
--शबलौ the two four-eyed
watch-dogs of Yama; cf.

1 Night, particularly a
[]
dark night; श्मामां श्यामलिमानमानयत
भोः सांद्रैर्मषीकूर्चकैः

.
--2
Shade, shadow.
--3 A dark
woman.
--4 A kind of woman
(यौवनमध्यस्था according to Malli. on

; or
शीते सुखोष्णसर्वांगी ग्रीष्मे या सुखशीतला ।
तप्तकांचनवर्णाभा सा स्री श्यामोति कथ्यते
according to one commentator on

and 8. 100).
--5 A
woman who has borne no children.
--6
A cow.
--7 Turmeric.
--8 The
female cuckoo.
--9 The Priyaṅgu
creeper;

.
--10
The indigo plant.
--11 The holy
basil.
--12 The seed of the lotus.
--13
N. of the Yamunā.
--14 N. of
several plants.

1 A kind of edible grain
(कंगु).
--2 A gramineous plant.
--कं
A kind of grass; cf. श्यामाक.

श्यामल a. Black, dark-blue,
blackish; निशितश्यामलस्निग्धमुखी शक्तिः

.
--लः
1 Black colour.
--2
Black pepper.
--3 A large bee.
--4
The sacred fig-tree.
--ला N. of
Durgā.

श्यामलिमन् m. Blackness,
darkness; श्यामां श्यामलिमानमान यत भोः
सांद्रैर्मषीकूर्त्रकैः

श्यामायते Den. A. To become
black, to prove impure (as gold
&c.); श्यामायते न युष्मासु यः
काचनभिवाग्निषु

.
--2
Impurity, alloy, (of metals &c.); हेम्नः
संलक्ष्यते ह्यग्नौ विशुद्धिः श्यामिकापि बा

1 A wife's brother.
--2
A wretched brother-in-law.

श्यालकी, श्यालिका, श्याली A wife's
sister.

श्यालकी, श्यालिका, श्याली A wife's
sister.

श्यालकी, श्यालिका, श्याली A wife's
sister.

श्याव a. (वा or वी f.) [श्यै-वन्]
1 Dark-brown, dark, dusky.
--2 Bay,
brown.
--वः The brown colour.
--Comp.
--तैलः the mango tree.
--दत्, --दंत a. brown-toothed.

स्यंद्^1 {c1c} A. (स्यंदते, सस्यंदे,
अस्यदत्-अस्यंत्त-अस्यंदिष्ट, स्यंत्स्यति-ते, स्यंदिष्यते,
स्यंदितुं-स्यंत्तुं, स्यन्न; desid. सिस्यंदिषते,
सिस्यंत्सति-ते; the स् of स्यंद् is changed to ष् after
a preposition ending in इ or उ)
1 To
ooze, trickle, drop, drip, distil, flow;
अयि दलदरविंद स्यंदमानं मरंदं तव
किमपि लिहंतो मंजु गुंजंतु भृंगाः

.
--2 To shed, pour forth.
--3 To
run, flee.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170110. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/332,.

स्यदः Speed, rapid motion, rush,
velocity.

स्यंदः [स्यंद्-भावे घञ्]
1 Flowing,
trickling.
--2 Going rapidly, moving.
--3 A car, chariot.

.
--नः
1
A war-chariot, a car or chariot in
general; धर्मारण्यं प्रविशति गजः
स्यंदनालोकभीतः Ś. 1. 33.
--2 Air, wind.
--3 A kind of tree (तिनिश).
--नं
1
Flowing, trickling, oozing.
--2
Rushing, going or flowing quickly.
--3
Water.
--Comp.
--आरोहः a warrior
who fights while seated in a chariot.

1 Saliva.
--2 A cow
bearing two calves at the same time.

स्यम् {c1c} P., {c10c} U. (स्यमति, स्यमय,
ति-ते)
1 To sound, to cry aloud,
shout.
--2 To go.
--3 To consider,
reflect (Atm. only in this sense).

स्यमंतकः A kind of valuable
gem^1 (said to yield daily eight loads
of gold and to preserve from all
kinds of dangers and portents).
(For some account, see the word
सत्राजित्).
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar and Jim Funderburk on 20210104. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/20.

स्यमि(मी)कः [स्यम्-ईकक्]
1 A
cloud.
--2 An ant-hill.
--3 A kind of
tree.
--4 Time.

स्यमि(मी)कः [स्यम्-ईकक्]
1 A
cloud.
--2 An ant-hill.
--3 A kind of
tree.
--4 Time.

स्यात् ind. (Strictly 3rd. pers.
sing. of the Potential of अस् ‘to be’)
It may be, perhaps, per chance.
--Comp.
--वादः an assertion of
probability (in phil.), a form of
scepticism.
--वादिन् m. a sceptic.
